item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 10 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 10 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 17 August 2026(Monday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Batangas(Calatagan, Lian, Balayan, Tuy, Calaca, Lemery, Mabini, Tingloy, Batangas City, San Pascual, Bauan, San Luis, Taal, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Batangas(Nasugbu, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lobo, San Jose, Taysan, Laurel) and Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Magallanes, Alfonso, General Emilio Aguinaldo).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Indang, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, Carmona), Batangas(Balete, Tanauan, Lipa, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Juan, Santo Tomas, Talisay), Laguna(San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, Los Banos, Bay, Calauan, Alaminos, San Pablo), Quezon(San Antonio, Tiaong), Tarlac(San Clemente, Camiling, Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban, Santa Ignacia), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao, Mabalacat, Angeles, Masantol, Macabebe, Sasmuan, Guagua, Santa Rita, Minalin, Bacolor, Apalit, Santo Tomas, San Fernando, San Simon, Mexico) and Bulacan(Bulakan, Malolos, Calumpit, Paombong, Hagonoy, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Meycauayan, Marilao, Bocaue, Obando, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Plaridel, Pulilan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang, San Luis, Santa Ana), Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, Pandi, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael), Laguna(Liliw, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Dolores, Candelaria, Sariaya, Lucban, Tayabas, Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucena, Pagbilao, Atimonan) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
